work.title: Correlate execution identity and skill composition
work.description: Use recorded execution information to report correlations by role, harness, model, skill identity, skill version, and effective skill composition digest, clearly identified as correlation rather than causation.
acceptance: Every correlation has a minimum sample count
Small samples are marked as inconclusive
Model and harness names are reported exactly as recorded
No ranking is produced without evidence counts
Results can compare different skill compositions for the same stage
